name: Doki Doki Our Time
storyline: After the bitter ending of the original game, you can make Monika come back. This time, you can finally give her the happiness she's always wanted. In an alternative timeline split from the original story, you can finally be with Monika. Fall in love with her all over again in a sweet, romantic and touching story. Featuring new CG's and settings, Our Time is the perfect mod for anyone who wanted Just Monika.
summary: Doki Doki: Our Time is a popular mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! (DDLC) that focuses on expanding Monika's story, allowing the player to finally have a happy ending with her. Unlike the original DDLC experience, where Monika is aware of her existence as a game character and manipulates the events of the story, this mod seeks to give her a second chance - a world where she can live out a true romance with the protagonist.
